scientific_integrity: Universal proof is algebraic and invokes Dirichlet theorem; bundled finite checks are supporting tests, not replacements for the infinite argument.
scientific_limitations: Does not determine every fixed divisor d_p or prove simultaneous auxiliary-prime divisibility; period q^q-1 need not be least. Known Touchard congruences are inputs, not original contributions. Potential implicit coverage in older fixed-divisor literature cannot be excluded.
title: Unbounded auxiliary prime divisors in prime-index Touchard fixed divisors
